name: Glacier Bay National Park and Preserve
policyReason: Pets are allowed on land in only a few developed areas; never on trails, beaches or in the backcountry.
summary: Pets are allowed on land in only a few developed areas; never on trails, beaches or in the backcountry.

excerpts.quote: Pets are allowed on land in only a few select areas, and may not be left unattended.
Pets are not allowed on trails, beaches, or anywhere in the backcountry, with the exception of pets that remain on board private vessels on the water.

dogRules.text: No trails, boardwalks, beaches or backcountry.
Pets may stay aboard private boats on the water.
